notes: An unofficial Go homage to Nous Research's Hermes Agent on PiG. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nous Research. Pinned against NousResearch/hermes-agent commit 45e9584556a97f50a3cb6394a6e7f6afa97bb66a; parity is a goal, not a promise. PARITY.md lists every ported, host-native, and out-of-scope surface.

Fuses into a single Go binary with zero PiG built-in tools: the model sees Hermes's read_file, write_file, patch, search_files, terminal, process_manage, memory, skills_list, skill_view, skill_manage, session_search, delegate_task, todo_list, clarify, cronjob_manage, web_search, web_extract, and execute_code.

Exposes shared library pig-hermes-core, versioned EventBus channels, named SystemPromptSections, and a composable clihook dispatcher so derived Piglets such as oh-my-hermes-pig layer cleanly via extends:.
